mainEntity.name: What is muscle toning and how does it differ from muscle building?

acceptedAnswer.text: Muscle toning typically refers to reducing body fat while increasing muscle definition, giving a firm and sculpted appearance. It involves a combination of resistance training to build muscle and cardiovascular exercise, along with a balanced diet, to decrease body fat. Muscle building, or hypertrophy, focuses primarily on increasing muscle size and mass through heavier resistance training and a caloric surplus. At Cave Training, our functional-fitness approach can support both goals, emphasizing movements that build strength and definition while improving overall fitness. The difference often lies in the intensity and volume of training, as well as nutritional strategies.
acceptedAnswer.description: Muscle toning focuses on definition by reducing fat and building lean muscle, while muscle building prioritizes increasing muscle size. Both involve resistance training, but the approach to diet and exercise intensity varies.
